{{2018 European Athletics Championships}}
The '''men's [[400 metres hurdles]]''' at the [[2018 European Athletics Championships]] took place at the [[Olympic Stadium (Berlin)|Olympic Stadium]] on 6, 7 and 9 August.<ref name="eaa">{{cite web|url=http://www.european-athletics.org/competitions/european-athletics-championships/2018/athletics/event/mens-400m-hurdles/|title=400m Hurdles Men|website=[[European Athletic Association]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180810054245/http://www.european-athletics.org/competitions/european-athletics-championships/2018/athletics/event/mens-400m-hurdles/|archive-date=2018-08-10|url-status=dead}}</ref>

==Results==
===Round 1===
First 2 in each heat (Q) and the next fastest 5 (q) advance to the Semifinals.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.european-athletics.org/externalmodules/AT/pdf/ATM044900_C74A.pdf|title=Round 1 results|website=[[European Athletic Association]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161120135721/http://www.european-athletics.org/externalmodules/AT/pdf/ATM044900_C74A.pdf|archive-date=2016-11-20|url-status=dead}}</ref> 11 fastest entrants awarded bye to Semifinals.
